observations.text: The batch was terminated at 82 h (planned 96 h) due to onset of cell death and the appearance of white cells during centrifugation.
During the initial batch phase, exponential growth was observed as the yeast utilized the available nutrients in the batch medium.
Cultivation was completed at 96 h as planned; however, white cells and partial cell death were observed during the later stages of the run.
Cultivation was terminated at 84 h due to onset of pigment loss (white cells) and signs of cell death observed during centrifugation.
Cultivation was ended at 74 h; toward the end of the run, white cells and signs of cell death were observed, indicating persistent pigment instability in late phase.
After 24 hours of fermentation, 200 mL of Isopropyl Myristate (IPM) was added directly to the reactor.
Cultivation was carried out up to 120 h; after ~108 h, a slight decline in OD/WCW was observed and late-phase pigment loss/cell death occurred later than in earlier batches.
Cultivation was carried out up to 120 h; after ~114 h, a slight decrease in OD/WCW was observed, with culture stability largely maintained up to the final time point.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df = pd.read_csv('/Users/dibyochakraborty/Docling_Parse/out/cli_carotenoid_v2/bundles/bundle_multi_20260503T151153Z_d31381/characterization/observations.csv')

# Let's see the max values and final values for OD and WCW
summary = df[df['variable'].isin(['od600_au', 'wcw_g_l'])].groupby(['run_id', 'variable']).agg(
    max_val=('value', 'max'),
    max_time=('time_h', lambda x: x.loc[x.idxmax()] if not x.empty else np.nan),
    final_val=('value', 'last'),
    final_time=('time_h', 'max')
).reset_index()

print(summary.to_string())

# Let's also check the feed rate and DO
feed_do = df[df['variable'].isin(['feed_rate_l_per_h', 'do_pct_saturation'])].groupby(['run_id', 'variable']).agg(
    mean_val=('value', 'mean'),
    min_val=('value', 'min'),
    max_val=('value', 'max')
).reset_index()
print("\nFeed and DO:")
print(feed_do.to_string())

failures.summary: Premature termination and cell death due to pigment loss (white cells) observed across multiple runs (RUN-0001 at 82h, RUN-0003 at 84h, RUN-0004 at 74h).
Late-stage cell death and pigment loss observed in RUN-0002 (completed at 96h) and RUN-0005 (after ~108h).

trends.summary: Addition of 200 mL Isopropyl Myristate (IPM) at 24h in RUN-0005 delayed the onset of pigment loss and cell death until ~108h.
RUN-0006 maintained culture stability up to 120h with only a slight decrease in OD/WCW after 114h.

analysis.summary: Severe data truncation in observations.csv compared to narrative reports: RUN-0001 ends at 48h (reported 82h), RUN-0002 ends at 0h (reported 96h), RUN-0004 ends at 60h (reported 74h), and RUN-0006 ends at 96h (reported 120h).

open_questions.question: Why is the numerical data for RUN-0002 missing after 0h, and why are RUN-0001, RUN-0004, and RUN-0006 truncated before their reported termination times?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Missing data prevents numerical analysis of the late-stage cell death and pigment loss events described in the narrative.

response.narrative: The fermentation campaign experienced recurrent issues with late-stage cell death and pigment loss (appearance of white cells) across multiple runs. RUN-0001, RUN-0003, and RUN-0004 were prematurely terminated between 74h and 84h due to these issues. RUN-0002 and RUN-0005 also exhibited these symptoms but reached or neared their planned durations. An intervention in RUN-0005 (addition of 200 mL Isopropyl Myristate at 24h) successfully delayed the onset of cell death and pigment loss until ~108h. RUN-0006 showed the best stability, maintaining culture viability up to 120h with only a slight decrease in biomass after 114h. Notably, the numerical data provided in the observations dataset is severely truncated compared to the narrative reports, with RUN-0002 missing all data after 0h, and several other runs missing their final 14-34 hours of data, preventing quantitative analysis of the cell death events.
